課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 透過此課程，學生可以學習到基礎固體地球科學知識與技能，有助於深造地科相關之進階課程與建立研究題目。
課程綱要.授課內容: 此課程包括固體地球相關之主要子題，為中央研究院國際研究生學程(地球科學學程)的五大領域之一。子題計有地質學、地球物理學、地球化學等。課程的目的為學習基礎固體地球科學知識與技能，有助於深造地科相關之進階課程與建立研究題目。通過講授、實習與研討，學生將更了解地球系統的運作方式以及它們的關連性。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. Earle, S., 2019. Physical Geology – 2nd Edition. Victoria, B.C.: BCcampus. Retrieved from https://opentextbc.ca/physicalgeology2ed/. 2. Fowler, C.M.R., 2004. The Solid Earth – An Introduction to Global Geophysics – 2nd Edition. Cambridge University Press.

課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: In this course I introduce the basic concepts of how volcanoes work without assuming some prior knowledge of volcanology from the students. The only prior knowledge needed is some physics, calculus and the basics of seismology. The objective is to familiarize the students with how volcanoes work, how they erupt, what hazards these eruptions entail and how volcanoes can be monitored and studied using primarily seismology, but also other methods.
課程綱要.授課內容: The course will start from recognizing the fact that volcanism is the direct consequence of plate tectonics and describe in more detail this relationship. This will be followed by a description of the plumbing system beneath volcanoes, why and how eruptions occur, what are their hazards. In the second part of the course emphasis will be given on the use of seismology for monitoring volcanoes and for probing their internal structure (i.e. seismic tomography).
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. Parfitt E. A. and L. Wilson, 2008. Fundamentals of physical volcanology, Blackwell publishing, 230 pp. 2. Shearer P. M., 2018. Introduction to seismology, Cambridge University Press, 396 pp. 3. Zobin V. M., 2012. Introduction to volcanic seismology, Elsevier Ltd, 482 pp.

課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 地震學是探測地球結構和理解震源特性的關鍵工具，而大規模地震的強地動可能會導致嚴重的災損。"高頻地震學"的目標是教授地球物理學/地震學專業學生有關震波傳遞和震源特性的概念，這堂課也會傳達強地動和地震危害的概念。
課程綱要.授課內容: 這門課程將涵蓋以下主題：應力、應變、彈性張量、波動方程解算、體波傳播、反射、傳輸、衰減、體波在地球的傳播時間、地球模型、震源、格林函數、震矩張量、場址效應、強地動預估和地震危害。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Modern global seismology, Lay and Wallace, Academic Press, 1995. 4.20 - Physical Processes That Control Strong Ground Motion, Anderson, J. G., 2015, Treatise on Geophysics (Second Edition), Elsevier.
課程綱要.辦公時間: 郭俊翔老師：Monday and Tuesday 10 am – 4 pm, Room S306, Department of Earth Sciences, NCU.

課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: Isotope geochemistry has grown over the last 50 years to become one of the most important fields in the earth sciences as well as in geochemistry. It has played an important role in transforming geology from a qualitative, observational science to a modern quantitative one. This course will start from fundamental principles then touch on many, though not all, of the applications of isotope geochemistry. We’ll focus first on geochronology will be focused first and then consider how radiogenic isotopes have been used to understand the origin and evolution of the Earth. Next, applications of stable isotope geochemistry to fields as diverse as paleoclimate, paleontology, archeology, ore genesis, and magmatic evolution will be examined. In addition, how the horizons of stable isotope geochemistry have broadened from a few light elements such as hydrogen, carbon, and oxygen to much of the periodic table will be shown. Finally, isotope geochemistry of the noble gases, whose isotopic variations are due to both nuclear and chemical processes and provide special insights into the origins and behavior of the Earth will be considered.
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. Introduction
2. Decay systems and Geochronology I
3. Geochronology II
4. Mass spectrometry and analytical result assessment
5. Radiogenic isotope geochemistry of the mantle
6. Radiogenic isotope geochemistry of the lithosphere
7. Radiogenic isotope geochemistry of the ocean
8. Stable isotope geochemistry I-theory
9. Stable isotope geochemistry II-appl.
10. Stable isotope geochemistry III-appl.
11. Stable isotope geochemistry IV (non-traditional)
12. Noble gas isotope geochemistry
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 1. Isotope Geochemistry, 2014. William M. White, John Wiley ＆ Sons (pub.), 495p. 2. Isotope Geology, 2008. Claude J. Allegre, Cambridge (pub.), 512p. 3. Principle of Isotope Geology, 2nd Edition, 1986. Gunter Faure, Wiley ＆ Sons (pub.), 589p.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Term presentation: 50％ Mid-term assignment: 30％ Performance in Class: 20％
課程綱要.課程領域: 基礎學科(共同) 、 固態地球科學
